A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Clear from
the beginning.

Affimaro is a product of Highlink.

Who pays the affiliate?

The business pays its affiliates directly. Affimaro is designed to calculate commissions and keep payment records. It does not hold or transfer commission funds.

Can I connect my store today?

This first version is an interactive product preview using sample data. A live WooCommerce integration, account system and backend still need to be built before real tracking can start.

What can I try in the demo?

Add sample affiliates and orders, edit program rules, approve commissions, apply refunds and record example payments. Changes stay in your browser and you can reset them at any time.

Will there be a mobile app?

A mobile app is planned to share the same account system for sales, commissions and notifications. You can already explore the responsive website and sample dashboards on your phone.
